title: EntropicWellsConfig
description: Configuration schema for KHANARY entropic-gravity semantic wells (v4: tensor-bundle grounding with type-(p,q) sections, local metric tensors, Jacobian transitions, and inscribed mesh curvature). Wells are overlaid onto FoldGraph B via GML anchor_node_id; they are derived geometry and cannot mutate B directly.

topology_target.description: Topology map identifier. 'B' = FoldGraph B (canonical semantic topology).

euler_triangle_bound.description: Euler triangle inequality: circumradius_R >= 2 * inradius_r for any nondegenerate triangle.

tensor_coordinate_transform.description: Tensor coordinate law: upper indices transform by the Jacobian and lower indices by the inverse Jacobian.

planck_length_lp_sq.description: l_P² proxy; 0.25 in natural units (Bekenstein-Hawking N = A/4l_P²).

system_clock_omega.description: System clock rate Ω (Hz); used for Unruh temperature scaling.

anchor_node_id.description: GML overlay node ID this well is anchored to. Must match a node in FoldGraph B's GML layer.

structural_entropy_metrics.description: Geodesic and simplicial entropy characterization for this well (v2).

geodesic_entropy_hg.description: H_G: Shannon entropy of shortest-path distance distribution from this anchor. Low = central hub; High = scattered region.

triangular_entropy_h_delta.description: H_Δ: 3-node simplicial complex error metric. Low = stable equilateral mesh; High = warped/mismatched relations.

mesh_density_triangles.description: Count of verified 2-simplices (closed 3-node triangles) incident on this well's anchor node.

max_bits_n.description: N = A/(4l_P²) — maximum information bits (Bekenstein-Hawking bound).

temperature_unruh.description: T_U = ℏa/(2πck_B) proxy — Unruh surface temperature.

internal_energy_e.description: E: internal energy of the semantic well (equipartition: E = ½NkT).

baseline_entropy_s.description: S: baseline information entropy at the well boundary.

potential_barrier_u.description: U: potential barrier height; high U = high resistance to streamline entry.

metric_tensor_g00.description: g_00: time-like metric component; negative = gravitational redshift proxy.

metric_tensor_g11.description: g_11: space-like metric component; >1 = stretched semantic distance.

divergence_sink_mass.description: Effective divergence mass for pathline_compute.hlsl sink detection. Negative = gravity well; positive = repulsion well.

admissible_risk_bound.description: R_minimax upper bound on loss_cost for paths admitted through this well.

jacobian_determinant.description: det(J): nonzero local coordinate-transition determinant for tensor transformation.

inscribed_mesh_geometry.description: Dual-circle projection geometry for local 3-node simplicial loops. This is derived mesh geometry over B, not Fold authority.

circumradius_R.description: R: radius of the circumscribed circle/holographic horizon around the local semantic triangle.

inradius_r.description: r: radius of the incircle/compression core inside the semantic triangle.

circumcenter_coord.description: O=(x,y,z), the projection-space circumcenter used for balance/stress diagnostics.

triangular_entropy_h_delta.description: H_Δ copied or specialized for this inscribed mesh horizon.

riemann_curvature_scalar.description: Local scalar curvature diagnostic for the inscribed mesh region.

tensor_field_type.description: Tensor bundle section type for this well. Geometry only; does not confer semantic authority.

local_metric_tensor_g_ij.description: Symmetric local Riemannian/pseudo-Riemannian metric tensor components for tensor-bundle projection.
